traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and technical requirements for story 010.1-DEV-CONFIGURABLE-PATTERNS are implemented and verified. The valid-annotation-format rule exposes both nested and flat configuration fields for custom story and requirement ID patterns, validates regex strings safely with clear configuration errors, falls back to default behavior when patterns are omitted or invalid, and incorporates optional example strings into error messages. ESLint schema for these options is defined and used, extensive tests explicitly tied to this story validate behavior (including precedence and error messaging), the documentation explains configuration with concrete examples, and the full Jest test suite passes. The rule’s defaults and behavior align with the valid-story-reference rule’s expectations, satisfying the integration and consistency aspects of the story.
